summary_en: On November 9, 2026, the company authorized acquisition of up to 30,000 ordinary shares (1.31% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) at a fixed price of ¥2,878 per share via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading on November 10, 2026, for a maximum outlay of ¥86.34 million.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Own Shares and Purchase of Own Shares via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On November 9, 2026, Kanda Tsushinki's board of directors authorized the acquisition of its own shares based on Article 165(3) of the Companies Act. The company committed to placing a buy order for up to 30,000 shares at the day's closing price of ¥2,878 per share via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading at 8:45 a.m. on November 10, 2026. The maximum total expenditure is ¥86.34 million, representing 1.31% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock. The order is valid only during the specified trading session and will be executed on a best-effort basis against available sell orders; partial or complete cancellation is possible depending on market conditions. Results will be disclosed after the 8:45 a.m. trading session concludes. The company stated the rationale as improving capital efficiency and executing flexible capital policy in response to changing business environments. As of September 30, 2026, the company held 324,741 shares of treasury stock against 2,298,486 shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock).
